description: Search active US clinical trials by location, condition slug, phase, study type, intervention type, recruitment status, sex eligibility, age bucket, healthy-volunteer flag, and facility name. Returns up to 50 trials per page with an opaque cursor for further pagination. Cursors are tied to the exact filter set used to issue them - reusing a cursor with a different filter set returns invalid_cursor. Use state-only scope first when exploring a region, then narrow to city for facility-level detail.

age.description: Age bucket for eligibility matching. 'child' = 0-17 years, 'adult' = 18-64 years, 'senior' = 65+ years. Maps to AACT minimum_age/maximum_age boundaries server-side.

city.description: US city name. Allows letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, and periods. Examples: "San Francisco", "St. Louis", "O'Fallon", "Wilkes-Barre". Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; maximum 100 characters.

condition.description: Condition to filter by: a curated slug ('breast-cancer'), its label ('Breast Cancer') or a condition name as it appears in trial records ('Breast Neoplasms'). Case-insensitive. Call clinicaltrials_list_conditions to see the valid values; an unrecognized condition is rejected with suggestions, never ignored.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call's nextCursor field. Omit to start from the beginning of the result set. Cursors are tied to the exact filter set used to issue them - reusing a cursor with different filters returns an invalid_cursor error.

facility.description: Exact facility name match. Scopes results to trials running at this named site.

items.description: Intervention type. One of: "DRUG", "DEVICE", "BEHAVIORAL", "PROCEDURE", "BIOLOGICAL", "DIAGNOSTIC_TEST", "DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT", "RADIATION", "COMBINATION_PRODUCT", "GENETIC", "OTHER". Values match AACT's canonical enum exactly (uppercase).

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Integer in [1, 50]. Default 20.

items.description: Trial phase. One of: "Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Phase 4", "N/A" - or the raw value a trial record reports ("PHASE1", "EARLY_PHASE1", "PHASE2", "PHASE3", "PHASE4", "NA"). Combined-phase trials (e.g. Phase 1/Phase 2) surface under each component bucket, so a Phase 1 filter also matches a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.

sex.description: Biological sex eligibility filter. Use 'female' or 'male'. Trials open to both sexes are returned regardless of this filter.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX, FL). Case-insensitive on input; normalized to uppercase. DC is accepted. Full state names like 'California' are not accepted - use 'CA' instead.

items.description: Recruitment status. One of: "RECRUITING", "NOT_YET_RECRUITING", "ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION". The MCP server only exposes the three active statuses - completed, terminated, withdrawn, etc. are not searchable.
Trial study type from ClinicalTrials.gov. One of: "INTERVENTIONAL", "OBSERVATIONAL", "EXPANDED_ACCESS". Values match AACT's canonical enum exactly (uppercase).

name: clinicaltrials_search_trials

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. Absent when no more pages are available.

noMatchHints.description: Actionable suggestions to broaden the search, present only when totalMatching is zero.

searchCriteria.description: Echo of the applied filter set so the caller can confirm what the server interpreted.

city.description: Canonical city name resolved from the slug, present when city scope was used.

pageSize.description: Page size that was applied to produce this page of results.

state.description: Canonical state code applied to this search.

totalMatching.description: Total trials matching the filters across all pages.

trials.description: Trial records for the current page, sorted newest first by start_date.

conditions.description: Condition names from the trial record, split into an array.

eligibility.description: Eligibility summary as recorded in AACT.

firstLocation.description: Primary US facility city / state when present, null otherwise.

locationCount.description: Total number of US facilities running this trial.

phase.description: Raw AACT phase enum value (e.g. PHASE2, EARLY_PHASE1, NA), or null when absent.

sponsor.description: Lead sponsor name, or null when absent in AACT.

url.description: Hipa.ai page for this trial: plain-language summary, every US site and how to apply. Link this when presenting the trial.

title: Search Trials
